decisions.reason: The acceptance concerns author-name placement and title emphasis on the title page, not copyright-page content or presentation.
Keeping the title-page hierarchy unchanged does not alter chapter-image inclusion, timing, placement, or treatment.
The source decision concerns title-page hierarchy and does not change the dedication page or its content removals.
Although both requirements involve visual hierarchy, the accepted arrangement applies specifically to the author name and main title on the title page, not chapter headings or subtitles.
The title-page author/title arrangement does not affect body-text density or paragraph spacing.
The source decision does not change chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, pixelation, or other rendering constraints.
Acceptance of the title-page hierarchy has no effect on Mama's Hot Take italics or quotation treatment.
The source decision does not alter chapter-image selection, mapping, tone, or colour-palette review criteria.
A title-page layout choice does not change the requested publication-readiness, copyright, or paperback-publishing guidance.
The accepted title-page hierarchy does not modify manuscript prose, approved rewrites, or punctuation proofreading.

The local context addresses the interior title page's author-name and main-title hierarchy, not the separate paperback cover design or cover text.
